capabilities: Track service schedules by distance or months, plus insurance, registration and road tax renewals per vehicle
Log fuel and charging fills and compute real mileage with the full-tank method
Record expenses and attach receipts from the vault or the phone camera
Remind daily about overdue or due-soon items and show what needs attention in a dashboard
Export and import backups as JSON and CSV, including logs from Fuelio and Drivvo
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states the plugin is free, makes no network requests, and stores all data in its plugin data file; it also documents a limitation that decimal-comma numbers are not supported on CSV import.
motivation: The author built it because car apps want an account, show ads and keep history on their servers, while Garage keeps everything in the vault with no account, network or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track vehicle maintenance, running costs and renewal deadlines, and dedicated car apps typically require accounts and store history on external servers.
